//: Config overlay for the LEGACY STT backend (Azure Speech via Python sidecar).
The base `tauri.conf.json` no longer declares `externalBin`. The reason is concrete:
`externalBin` is resolved by tauri-build in a BUILD SCRIPT, so with it in the
base even a `cargo check` would fail with "resource path binaries/nora-stt-sidecar-
<triple>.exe doesn't exist" — forcing anyone who just wants to typecheck the Rust to
run PyInstaller first. With the local backend as the default, the Python sidecar
became optional and cannot be a build prerequisite.
Usage (only when packaging the bundle with the azure backend):
Tauri v2 MERGES this file on top of the base; whatever is not here is
inherited. `sttBackend` stays azure because a bundle that loads the sidecar is,
WARNING: a binary compiled with the `stt-azure` feature but packaged WITHOUT this
overlay does not find the sidecar at runtime. This degrades cleanly — the
"Sidecar binary not found" — not a crash, but it does not transcribe either.
